purpose: Track donor candidates, accepted donor annexes, contribution scope, and upgrade rules without allowing donor-specific surfaces to overwrite canonical loop law.

governance.canonical_principle: Canonical loop law remains donor-free. Donors are evidence sources and translation annexes, not the law itself.
acceptance_rule: A donor must arrive with a donor-specific annex packet or equivalent evidence bundle.
A donor must be reduced to generalized slots before it can affect canonical material-side law.
A donor is admitted for loop evidence, not merely style or novelty.
A donor may extend mapping examples, reward rotation hints, and red-flag watchlists without rewriting canonical law.
canonical_change_rule: A single donor cannot rewrite the core loop law by itself.
Canonical loop-law changes require either repeated evidence across multiple donors or one donor plus strong runtime/canary confirmation.
When donors disagree, conflicts are resolved at the generalized-slot layer, not by importing donor-specific nouns into canonical law.

donor_entries.label: Probe A Seed Donor
strengths: public proof to private receipt conversion
blocked_influence: direct import of donor proper nouns or organizations into canonical law
canonical threshold rewrite without stronger evidence
single-donor authority over late-game or all-block law
known_limits: opening and early-loop evidence is stronger than late-block evidence
donor-specific receipts are vivid but can overfit if not generalized
master-donor authority is not yet justified
contamination_risks: PB or named-seat vocabulary becoming pseudo-law instead of one example family
proof being described as donor cleverness rather than visible event
reward collapsing into donor-flavored receipt repetition
promotion_conditions: Probe A style evidence remains positive after loop scorecard is introduced
generalized-slot mapping continues to outperform donor-noun-heavy variants
late-block bounded evidence does not contradict opening-loop gains

onboarding_checklist: Create a donor annex packet or equivalent evidence bundle.
Extract donor surfaces into generalized slot mappings.
Record strengths, limits, and contamination risks.
Declare allowed influence and blocked influence.
Register the donor without changing canonical law yet.
Validate the donor through loop-oriented canary comparisons before law promotion.

deprecate_when: A donor repeatedly underperforms on loop scorecard checks.
A donor cannot be generalized without persistent contamination.
A better donor or donor bundle supersedes its contribution.
retain_as_reference_when: The donor still provides useful red flags or example mappings.
The donor remains historically important to explain prior design choices.
